utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we settle on this Saturday at the Maple Street spot, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, this Saturday at the Maple Street repair drive spot is set. If you can, bring any tools you have and maybe a couple of spare extension cords or batteries.

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — let me know the top priority, and I’ll jump in where I can when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, I’m still able to help with the repair drive. I’ll keep track of supplies and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll check what’s missing and send you a quick list soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still in, and I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive. I can also help round up a few more volunteers if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Quinn — thank you. If you can round up a few more volunteers, I’ll handle the rest of the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it, Sam — I’ll start rounding up a few more volunteers right away and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re meeting at the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday on Maple Street works for me. I’ll bring what tools I can and be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Eli. I’ve got Maple Street marked for Saturday, and I’ll let you know if anything else needs picking up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming—you’re still able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Kira — yes, they could still use both tools and donations for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — the biggest help right now is spreading the word and gathering any small repair items folks can bring. I’ll send the exact time and list for Sunday at the community center as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can help spread the word and keep an eye out for small repair items. Send me the time and list for Sunday when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Tess — I can bring the hammer and screwdriver for the repair drive. What else do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Gus — hammers and screwdrivers are top of the list. If you can, maybe bring a tape measure too; I’m checking what else folks still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Tess — I’ll bring a tape measure too. Just let me know if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have we set the date for the repair drive yet? And what do they still need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, as far as I know. I can ask around and find out which date works best, plus what supplies or help they still need most.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks everyone. Let’s start with the hammer and screwdriver, and I’ll send the first task list.

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — it’s at the community center on Sunday, and please bring gloves, basic tools, and any spare supplies you have. I’ll make sure we’re all set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still able to help, yes. Let’s just get the date and the main fixes settled so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming—you’re still able to help with the repair drive after school pickup, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, earlier in the afternoon still works for you, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, but I’m in if you need help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — that’s really kind of you. We’re meeting at the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday, and I’ll make sure you get the details on what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly tools and a few spare parts would help most. I’ll keep track of what comes in and what we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can bring some tools and a few spare parts. Just tell me what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, and I’m putting the final details together. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks for the update, Rosa — I’ll pass along that it’s now Sunday at the community center. What do you want me to help tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Could you help spread the updated time and venue, and maybe start a quick list of repair items people can bring?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard the repair drive is meeting at the spot on Maple Street this Saturday, and folks are still gathering tools and making the fix-up list. If you want, I can ask around for the latest details on what to bring and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess — please do. I’ll keep spreading the word so more neighbors know where to show up and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear what to bring and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—do they still need any tools or donations for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think they still need a few tools and maybe some donations, but I should check what’s top priority. I’ll keep you posted as soon as I know the next fix for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Oren — keep me posted, and I can help spread the word once you know what’s most needed.
